{{Top|leg}}
'''Gassers''' were ovens used by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]]. Prior to the invention of the gasser, Gungans would dig pits in the ground for baking.<ref name="game">''[[Episode I Adventures 11: Pirates from Beyond the Sea]]''</ref>
